style: Playful hand-drawn cartoon pizza style: thick clean dark outlines, flat warm colors (tomato red, cheese yellow, crust golden brown, basil green), slight paper-grain texture, friendly and fun. Square 1024x1024 canvas. Keep all important content inside the central circle (a circular crop will be applied), leaving the outer corners completely empty and transparent (except full-canvas backgrounds). No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.

A classic black pinstripe mafia fedora with a red band and a small pepperoni pin, tilted slightly, placed at the top-center of the canvas. Transparent background, only the hat. Isolated object, nothing else: fully transparent background everywhere outside the object, no stray toppings, crumbs, drips, shadows, glow or decorations in the corners or edges of the canvas.
